parts.text: A student investigated the rate of reaction between zinc and excess hydrochloric acid, at 20 ° C. 2 g of zinc powder was added to 50 cm 3 of dilute hydrochloric acid. dilute hydrochloric acid zinc gas syringe The volume of hydrogen released was measured every 30 seconds.
